claims.claim: Contracts Finder is free to use.
claims.quote: Contracts Finder is free to use.
claims.note: The guidance explicitly says it is free.

claims.claim: Any business or organisation can use Contracts Finder to seek public sector supply opportunities.
claims.quote: You can use Contracts Finder to: search for contract opportunities in different sectors
claims.note: The text describes searching opportunities but does not explicitly establish access for every business or organisation.

claims.claim: Central government contracts above £12,000 must be published on Contracts Finder.
claims.quote: central government authorities [footnote 3] , where the contract value is at least £12,000 [footnote 4] inclusive of VAT;
claims.note: The £12,000 threshold is stated, but publication duties are limited to in-scope procurements and may have exemptions.

claims.claim: Contracts above £25,000 from other public bodies must be published on Contracts Finder.
claims.quote: sub-central contracting authorities, NHS Trusts and NHS Foundation Trusts where the contract value is at least £30,000 [footnote 5] inclusive of VAT.
claims.note: The stated threshold for these other authorities is £30,000 including VAT, not £25,000.
